title: Taipei Story House
geometryLabel: Historic Tudor-style house, entrance balcony/round steps, own roof turrets and small rear terrace. Detached park/cafe buildings and modern access enclosure excluded.
identityStatus: Two selected original exterior photos inspected; precise main-house map polygon confirmed by Taipei Story House POI and aerial roof context. Article point is offset toward neighboring police station.

orientationControl.basis: Protruding semicircular entry faces west-southwest; long facade runs south-southeast. Cross gable sits at the positiveX end and main gable faces negativeX. Aerial resolves roof ridges and detached cafe to the south.

terrainContact.basis: Dry entrance garden path beyond the semicircular steps; independent host-ground reference.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap; inspected local2010/2016 exterior originals; Taipei Department of Cultural Affairs architecture description; aerial roof context.
notes: Main mapped envelope about15m by16m including own entrance balcony. Two-storey red-brick/yellow timber house, steep copper roofs, branching timber patterns, Ionic entry balcony and spired square attic. Heights, secondary curved roof gables and unseen rear openings remain estimates. Nearest footprint to article point is a police station and is NOT this source.
limitations: Detached cafe, surrounding park, modern glazed access enclosure, signage and interiors excluded.
Independent terrain retained unchanged; current geographic review required before completion.
